goal: rewrite stale dogfood goldens and publish 0.4.3

summary.title: Recapture supported-workflow dogfood cases and ship 0.4.3
summary.what: Marked five unstable goldens stale, recaptured them with --cwd and distinctive tokens, and made the dogfood runner pass find.cwd as --cwd. Publishing ranking/elision/skill fixes as 0.4.3.
summary.why: Those candidates were testing --sort ended as a date window or unscoped short product names. The supported skill workflow already recovers the same sessions; the CLI should not grow a reranker to keep the old goldens green.
summary.user_goal: rewrite stale dogfood goldens and publish 0.4.3

decisions.point: How to treat the five remaining candidate fails
decisions.chose: Mark the old workflows stale and add new candidate goldens that use --cwd / distinctive tokens
decisions.rationale: The expected sessions are still indexed; the old queries asked the CLI to pretend --sort ended is --since, or to rank two source-specific Claude Code hits in one unscoped top5.
rejected: Promote the old cases to hard
Run relaxed recall when strict FTS already returned rows

decisions.chose: Pass --cwd through the runner instead of synthesizing a Codex-root --selector
decisions.rationale: Default find --cwd fans out across public sources. A Codex-only selector would drop the Claude Code recapture.

rejected.alternative: Edit goldens only and leave 0.4.1/0.4.2 CLI unchanged
rejected.reason: The ranking/elision/skill fixes are the actual product change; goldens are private and were rewritten to match supported usage

acknowledged_constraints.note: Did not enable relaxed recall on non-empty strict results
